params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $rows=@(); Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $env:USERPROFILE -Directory | ForEach-Object { if (Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName '.git')) { $url=& git -C $_.FullName remote get-url origin 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $url -match 'fengie/mhw-mods') { $branch=& git -C $_.FullName branch --show-current; $sha=& git -C $_.FullName rev-parse HEAD; $status=@(& git -C $_.FullName status --short); $rows += [pscustomobject]@{Path=$_.FullName;Branch=$branch;Sha=$sha;Status=$status} } } }; $rows | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
